items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: How did playing with the George Lewis band compare with any other bands you have played with, Dr. Rockwell?

ctx.x: I played with a high school band where we played on television and things like that, and won wristwatches, and I played it. Now, in 1954, I started a band called the Storyville Stompers in college. Let's see, in the 54, I guess so, but just various little jobs, you know, nothing of any importance.
How did playing with the George Lewis band compare with any other bands you have played with, Dr. Rockwell?

Well, the rhythm section, I would say it was probably the greatest musical experience of my life, even probably to this time, at least on banjo. I remember the third or fourth number was Chinatown, and the tempo was the only time in my life I've never been able to keep up on a 4-4 tempo, because it was... It was a little faster than that. And I remember looking around, and drag was keeping up, and I kept it up for two choruses, and I thought I was going to have a heart attack, and I went, you know, and these guys…
